items.author: KeyframeUI <https://keyframeui.com>

items.author: KeyframeUI <https://keyframeui.com>

items.name: tilt-card-feature-grid-demo

items.author: KeyframeUI <https://keyframeui.com>

items.title: Arc Scroll
items.description: Cards that travel along a semicircle as you scroll, entering at the bottom right and leaving at the bottom left.
items.author: KeyframeUI <https://keyframeui.com>

items.name: arc-scroll-demo

items.description: Eight cards on an arc, driven by scrolling inside the box.
items.author: KeyframeUI <https://keyframeui.com>

items.name: arc-scroll-case-studies-demo
items.title: Arc Scroll: Case Studies
items.description: A portfolio hero: project cards on the arc, with a pinned headline and a caption for the project at the top.
items.author: KeyframeUI <https://keyframeui.com>

items.name: arc-scroll-timeline-demo
items.title: Arc Scroll: Timeline
items.description: A company history with tighter spacing, the current year highlighted and a year rail that follows along.
items.author: KeyframeUI <https://keyframeui.com>

items.name: arc-scroll-testimonials-demo
items.title: Arc Scroll: Testimonials
items.description: Wide quote cards with tilt turned off so the text stays level, plus page dots.
items.author: KeyframeUI <https://keyframeui.com>

items.name: pluck-string
items.title: Pluck String
items.description: A divider that catches on the pointer as it crosses, bends with it, then slips free and twangs back on a bouncy spring.
items.author: KeyframeUI <https://keyframeui.com>

items.name: pluck-string-demo
items.title: Pluck String: Default
items.description: A divider between two blocks of text, with the default pull and spring.
items.author: KeyframeUI <https://keyframeui.com>

items.name: pluck-string-strum-demo
items.title: Pluck String: Strum
items.description: Six strings tuned like a guitar: thicker strings are softer and ring longer. Sweep down across all of them.
items.author: KeyframeUI <https://keyframeui.com>

items.name: pluck-string-changelog-demo
items.title: Pluck String: Changelog
items.description: Faded strings between release notes, with a softer highlight.
items.author: KeyframeUI <https://keyframeui.com>

items.name: zoom-lightbox
items.title: Zoom Lightbox
items.description: A thumbnail that grows into a full-screen photo, pages sideways, and shrinks back into its tile when you drag it down, like Apple Photos.
items.author: KeyframeUI <https://keyframeui.com>

items.name: zoom-lightbox-demo
items.title: Zoom Lightbox: Gallery
items.description: A photo grid. Tap a photo, swipe or use the arrow keys to page, then drag it down and it lands back in its tile.
items.author: KeyframeUI <https://keyframeui.com>

items.name: zoom-lightbox-products-demo
items.title: Zoom Lightbox: Product Images
items.description: A storefront grid with portrait tiles and rounder corners. Captions carry the name, colorway and price.
items.author: KeyframeUI <https://keyframeui.com>

items.name: zoom-lightbox-case-study-demo
items.title: Zoom Lightbox: Case Study
items.description: Shots spread through an article, in different grids. The viewer pages through them in reading order and scrolls each one into view so it has a tile to land in.
items.author: KeyframeUI <https://keyframeui.com>

items.name: morph-search
items.title: Morph Search
items.description: A search button that stretches into a search field, with results unfolding underneath as one shape, and shrinks back into the button when it closes.
items.author: KeyframeUI <https://keyframeui.com>

items.name: morph-search-demo
items.title: Morph Search: Nav Bar
items.description: A search button in a site header. It grows into a field with popular pages underneath; pick one to go there.
items.author: KeyframeUI <https://keyframeui.com>

items.name: morph-search-command-demo
items.title: Morph Search: Command Menu
items.description: An app's command menu. The trigger travels to the middle of the screen, with grouped commands and their shortcuts. Opens with ⌘K.
items.author: KeyframeUI <https://keyframeui.com>

items.name: morph-search-docs-demo
items.title: Morph Search: Docs Search
items.description: A docs header with a fake search field that becomes the real one. Press / to open it from anywhere.
items.author: KeyframeUI <https://keyframeui.com>

items.name: spotlight-tour
items.title: Spotlight Tour
items.description: A guided tour that dims the page and cuts a hole around one element at a time. The hole glides to each next element and takes its shape, with the explanation card riding along beside it.
items.author: KeyframeUI <https://keyframeui.com>

items.name: spotlight-tour-demo
items.title: Spotlight Tour: Product Onboarding
items.description: A first tour of a dashboard: the avatar, the toolbar, the New button and the sidebar. The hole goes from a circle to a long pill to a button to a tall panel. Clicking New moves the tour on.
items.author: KeyframeUI <https://keyframeui.com>

items.name: spotlight-tour-whats-new-demo
items.title: Spotlight Tour: What's New
items.description: Three new features spread down a page. Each one scrolls into view while the spotlight travels to it. The Live switch stays usable while it's highlighted.
items.author: KeyframeUI <https://keyframeui.com>

items.name: spotlight-tour-form-demo
items.title: Spotlight Tour: Form Help
items.description: A sign-up form that explains each field in turn. You can type into each field while it's highlighted.
items.author: KeyframeUI <https://keyframeui.com>

items.name: expand-card
items.title: Expand Card
items.description: A card that opens into a full article, growing from its place in the page to fill the screen, and shrinks back into its slot when you pull it down, like the App Store's Today tab.
items.author: KeyframeUI <https://keyframeui.com>

items.name: expand-card-demo
items.title: Expand Card: Today Feed
items.description: Three stories in different styles: a full-bleed photo, a top-five list and a bold card on a gradient. Tap one, then pull it down from the top, or press Esc, and it lands back in its slot.
items.author: KeyframeUI <https://keyframeui.com>

items.name: expand-card-changelog-demo
items.title: Expand Card: Changelog With Links
items.description: Each post has its own link. Opening one updates the URL, the back button closes it, and loading a post's link opens it directly. The notes load while the cover grows.
items.author: KeyframeUI <https://keyframeui.com>

items.name: expand-card-shop-demo
items.title: Expand Card: Shop
items.description: Product cards that open into a product page with close-ups and a size picker. Add something to the bag, then pull the page down to watch the count behind it change.
items.author: KeyframeUI <https://keyframeui.com>

items.name: counter-curtain
items.title: Counter Curtain
items.description: A curtain that covers the page while it loads, counting from 0 to 100 with the fonts and hero images, then lifts as the headline rises out of its masks underneath, on one clock.
items.author: KeyframeUI <https://keyframeui.com>

items.name: counter-curtain-demo
items.title: Counter Curtain: Studio Portfolio
items.description: The default counter over a studio's home page. The nav, headline, links and photo each rise as the curtain clears them. Press reload in the address bar to play it again.
items.author: KeyframeUI <https://keyframeui.com>

items.name: counter-curtain-launch-demo
items.title: Counter Curtain: Launch Page
items.description: A custom counter in the drop's colors, with a padded number and a progress bar, on a curtain that falls away. `onComplete` starts the countdown as it goes, so the clock is already ticking when it's uncovered.
items.author: KeyframeUI <https://keyframeui.com>

items.name: counter-curtain-editorial-demo
items.title: Counter Curtain: Editorial
items.description: The default counter set in serif on a stone curtain that slides off to the left. It waits for the three photos to load and decode, so they're sharp from the first frame.
items.author: KeyframeUI <https://keyframeui.com>

items.name: expanding-hero
items.title: Expanding Hero
items.description: A headline with a small video set between its words. As you scroll, the window opens until it fills the screen, pushing the words off its edges.
items.author: KeyframeUI <https://keyframeui.com>

items.name: expanding-hero-demo
items.title: Expanding Hero: Studio Reel
items.description: A motion studio's showreel opens out of the headline. Once it fills the box, a button plays the film full screen.
items.author: KeyframeUI <https://keyframeui.com>

items.name: expanding-hero-product-demo
items.title: Expanding Hero: Product Launch
items.description: An app screenshot instead of a video, built in markup so it stays sharp full screen. A "Watch the demo" button appears once it fills the box.
items.author: KeyframeUI <https://keyframeui.com>

items.name: expanding-hero-event-demo
items.title: Expanding Hero: Event
items.description: A conference hero with an aftermovie and a bolder headline. The date and city chips live inside the halves, so they fly off with the words.
items.author: KeyframeUI <https://keyframeui.com>

items.name: intro-loader
items.title: Intro Loader
items.description: A page-load intro that counts to 100 with the real loading while a flipbook of your work plays in a small frame, then grows the last image into its place on the page. It doesn't fade out: its last frame is the page's first.
items.author: KeyframeUI <https://keyframeui.com>

items.name: intro-loader-demo
items.title: Intro Loader: Studio
items.description: A studio's home page. Four projects flip past in the frame, then the fifth grows into the full-bleed hero, and the headline rises over it. Press reload in the address bar to play it again, or click to skip.
items.author: KeyframeUI <https://keyframeui.com>

items.name: intro-loader-lookbook-demo
items.title: Intro Loader: Lookbook
items.description: A season label instead of a number, and a tall frame for the looks. The last look lands as the half of the page beside the headline.
items.author: KeyframeUI <https://keyframeui.com>

items.name: intro-loader-wordmark-demo
items.title: Intro Loader: Wordmark
items.description: No images. The wordmark rises a letter at a time as the count runs, then shrinks and flies into the logo's spot in the header. The target can be anything.
items.author: KeyframeUI <https://keyframeui.com>

items.name: exploded-ui
items.title: Exploded UI
items.description: A product screenshot that comes apart into its layers as you scroll, explains each one, then clicks back together. The layers are real HTML, so text stays sharp and follows your theme.
items.author: KeyframeUI <https://keyframeui.com>

items.name: exploded-ui-demo
items.title: Exploded UI: Dashboard
items.description: A dashboard comes apart into its shell, sidebar, live cards, command menu and a teammate's cursor, walks through each one, then lands back as the screenshot it started as. Hover a layer once it's open, or click a label to jump to it.
items.author: KeyframeUI <https://keyframeui.com>

items.name: exploded-ui-architecture-demo
items.title: Exploded UI: Architecture
items.description: The layers don't have to be UI. Four plain planes, from your app down to the database, that stay open at the end. Each carries its name on its front edge, the strip that stays in view.
items.author: KeyframeUI <https://keyframeui.com>

items.name: exploded-ui-design-system-demo
items.title: Exploded UI: Design System
items.description: A page lifts off the components it's built from, which lift off the tokens under them. Numbered labels, with the active layer's description under the stack.
items.author: KeyframeUI <https://keyframeui.com>

items.name: odometer
items.title: Odometer
items.description: A number that rolls each digit on its own wheel, up when the value grows and down when it shrinks, and slides new digits in as the number gets longer.
items.author: KeyframeUI <https://keyframeui.com>

items.name: odometer-demo
items.title: Odometer: Default
items.description: Step the number up and down. Wheels roll the way the value moves, only the digits that change turn, and 999 → 1,000 widens as the new digit and comma roll in. Click fast: they redirect mid-roll.
items.author: KeyframeUI <https://keyframeui.com>

items.name: odometer-pricing-demo
items.title: Odometer: Pricing
items.description: Monthly and yearly plans. Prices roll down to the yearly rate and back up, the yearly total rolls down from a year of monthly bills, and Starter's $0 never moves.
items.author: KeyframeUI <https://keyframeui.com>

items.name: odometer-dashboard-demo
items.title: Odometer: Dashboard KPIs
items.description: Currency with cents, a count, a percentage and milliseconds. The range switcher makes big jumps in both directions; between them the numbers drift live while the cards are on screen, and the delta chips flip color and arrow with their sign.
items.author: KeyframeUI <https://keyframeui.com>

items.name: odometer-grouping-demo
items.title: Odometer: Indian Grouping
items.description: A rupee fundraiser that keeps ticking up. Switch between the Indian system of lakhs and crores (₹2,45,67,890) and international thousands (₹24,567,890): the commas roll to their new places while every digit stays put.
items.author: KeyframeUI <https://keyframeui.com>

items.name: odometer-stats-demo
items.title: Odometer: Landing Stats
items.description: A band of headline numbers that roll up from 0 the first time they scroll into view, one after another.
items.author: KeyframeUI <https://keyframeui.com>

items.name: hover-preview
items.title: Hover Preview
items.description: A list of names that opens a photo at the pointer. It trails the cursor with a little weight, leans as it moves, and wipes to the next photo from the direction you travel, like flipping through prints.
items.author: KeyframeUI <https://keyframeui.com>

items.name: hover-preview-demo
items.title: Hover Preview: Default
items.description: A studio's work index. Point at a project: its photo opens at the pointer and trails it. Move down the list and each photo wipes in from the top; move up and it comes from the bottom. Sweep fast to flip through them. Tab through the rows to see each photo without a mouse.
items.author: KeyframeUI <https://keyframeui.com>

items.name: hover-preview-team-demo
items.title: Hover Preview: Team
items.description: Names and roles, with a portrait on hover. The frame is taller and rounder, and leans a little less.
items.author: KeyframeUI <https://keyframeui.com>

items.name: hover-preview-journal-demo
items.title: Hover Preview: Journal
items.description: An archive of essays with dates and reading times. Each title shows its cover image in a wide 3:2 frame.
items.author: KeyframeUI <https://keyframeui.com>

items.name: playhead-reel
items.title: Playhead Reel
items.description: A whole archive in one thin strip, with a playhead that walks along it as you scroll. Whatever's under the playhead opens into a loose collage, and the ruler below is a scrubber you can drag.
items.author: KeyframeUI <https://keyframeui.com>

items.name: playhead-reel-demo
items.title: Playhead Reel: Default
items.description: A studio's archive: six projects, forty images. Scroll and the playhead walks the reel while each project opens into a collage under it, and the title rolls to the next as you cross into it. Scroll fast and the collage folds flat to let you skim. Hover a photo to lift it off the pile, click one to bring it under the playhead, or drag along the ruler.
items.author: KeyframeUI <https://keyframeui.com>

items.name: playhead-reel-changelog-demo
items.title: Playhead Reel: Changelog
items.description: Six releases as live UI mockups rather than screenshots, so they stay sharp and follow your theme. The header shows the version and date, and a caption for the screen under the playhead. Tab to the playhead and use the arrow keys: Shift jumps a release.
items.author: KeyframeUI <https://keyframeui.com>

items.name: playhead-reel-journal-demo
items.title: Playhead Reel: Travel Journal
items.description: A year of trips, one group each, in portrait and landscape. Each photo has its own caption, and the trip's dates and a day count sit above.
items.author: KeyframeUI <https://keyframeui.com>

items.name: sync-grid
items.title: Sync Grid
items.description: A grid of videos on one clock. Scrub any card and the rest follow it to the same moment. Stack them to flip between versions of a single frame, or drop one onto another to compare them side by side.
items.author: KeyframeUI <https://keyframeui.com>

items.name: sync-grid-demo
items.title: Sync Grid: Easing
items.description: One motion played with four easings. Each card plots its curve with a dot riding it, and moves a card into its slot with the same value. Hover to scrub and watch the others ripple after, or stack them to flip between easings at the exact same moment.
items.author: KeyframeUI <https://keyframeui.com>

items.name: sync-grid-models-demo
items.title: Sync Grid: Model Output
items.description: One prompt, four fictional video models. The clips run 7 to 21 seconds and line up by percentage, so halfway is halfway in all of them. Stack them and move up and down to flip between outputs on the same frame.
items.author: KeyframeUI <https://keyframeui.com>

items.name: sync-grid-render-demo
items.title: Sync Grid: Render Quality
items.description: One clip in four cards at 1/8, 1/4, 1/2 and full resolution. It decodes once and is drawn into each card, so all four always show the same frame. Drag Final onto Draft and switch to Difference: only the detail the draft lost lights up.
items.author: KeyframeUI <https://keyframeui.com>

items.name: sync-grid-redesign-demo
items.title: Sync Grid: Redesign
items.description: Three versions of one product's site, built from markup, each scrolling with the clock while the same visitor moves and clicks through it. Drag 2026 onto 2019 and slide the divider: the old and new layouts sit at the same scroll point.
items.author: KeyframeUI <https://keyframeui.com>

items.name: thought-trail
items.title: Thought Trail
items.description: An agent's steps as they happen. The step at work shimmers and streams its details; when the next one starts, it folds up into a one-line summary and the rail fills down to the new step. Click any summary to open it again.
items.author: KeyframeUI <https://keyframeui.com>

items.name: thought-trail-demo
items.title: Thought Trail: Default
items.description: A coding agent works through four steps. Each opens while it runs and folds into its summary as the next begins; the edit's diff scrolls inside its step, pinned to the newest line. When the run ends, the trail folds into its header. Click a summary to reopen it.
items.author: KeyframeUI <https://keyframeui.com>

items.name: thought-trail-chat-demo
items.title: Thought Trail: Chat Reasoning
items.description: A chat reply that thinks first. The message's parts are shaped like the AI SDK's, and each reasoning or tool part becomes a step. The trail folds into "Thought for 9s" as soon as the answer starts streaming below it.
items.author: KeyframeUI <https://keyframeui.com>

items.name: thought-trail-deploy-demo
items.title: Thought Trail: Deploy Log
items.description: A CI pipeline with every step listed up front as pending. Logs stream into the running step, pinned to the newest line, and each step keeps its time. Turn on Break a test: the run stops at the tests, which turn red and stay open, and the steps after them never start.
items.author: KeyframeUI <https://keyframeui.com>

items.name: thought-trail-research-demo
items.title: Thought Trail: Research Agent
items.description: Steps with their own icons. Sources collect as chips while the agent searches, pages tick off as it reads, and the answer cites what it found once the trail folds away. Open Found 9 sources to see them again.
items.author: KeyframeUI <https://keyframeui.com>

items.name: slice-gallery
items.title: Slice Gallery
items.description: Tall photo slices that share one width. The one you open widens into a full card while the others squeeze to make room; its title swings upright and the details slide up from under it.
items.author: KeyframeUI <https://keyframeui.com>

items.name: slice-gallery-demo
items.title: Slice Gallery: Project Covers
items.description: An architecture studio's selected work. Move across the row: a slice opens once the pointer settles, so a quick sweep doesn't make the row ripple. Each project's strip warms to its own color, and the details carry a link.
items.author: KeyframeUI <https://keyframeui.com>

items.name: slice-gallery-team-demo
items.title: Slice Gallery: Team Portraits
items.description: Six portraits in black and white, with the open one in color through `imageClassName`. The role takes the person's accent. On a phone the portraits stack; on a touch screen side by side, drag a finger across them to flip through faces.
items.author: KeyframeUI <https://keyframeui.com>

items.name: slice-gallery-hero-demo
items.title: Slice Gallery: Hero
items.description: A travel hero that plays on its own: the open slice's strip fills like a story timer, then the next place opens. Hovering pauses it. The counter above follows along through `index` and `onIndexChange`.
items.author: KeyframeUI <https://keyframeui.com>

items.name: stretch-index
items.title: Stretch Index
items.description: A list of rows that open in place. The row you're on grows taller, its tab widens into a photo, the title slides over to make room and the details rise out from under it, while the rows below glide down.
items.author: KeyframeUI <https://keyframeui.com>

items.name: stretch-index-demo
items.title: Stretch Index: Customer Stories
items.description: A product site's customer stories. Move down the list: a row opens once the pointer settles, so a quick sweep doesn't make the list ripple. Each company's tab warms to its own color and opens into a photo, and the whole row links to the story.
items.author: KeyframeUI <https://keyframeui.com>

items.name: stretch-index-careers-demo
items.title: Stretch Index: Open Roles
items.description: A careers page with `openOn="click"` and `numbered={false}`: rows open like an accordion, a second click closes them, and the Apply link inside stays clickable. In a narrow frame the team and place move under the title.
items.author: KeyframeUI <https://keyframeui.com>

items.name: stretch-index-episodes-demo
items.title: Stretch Index: Podcast Episodes
items.description: A podcast's latest episodes on a dark panel, with square covers through `imageAspect={1}` and episode numbers through `number`. With `collapseOnLeave`, the list folds shut when the pointer leaves it.
items.author: KeyframeUI <https://keyframeui.com>

items.name: redline
items.title: Redline
items.description: Figma-style redlines for any layout. Point at an element to see its size, padding and gaps, with lines and labels that glide from one element to the next. Pin one and hold Alt to measure the distance to another.
items.author: KeyframeUI <https://keyframeui.com>
items.docs: Live preview, examples and props: https://keyframeui.com/components/redline

items.name: redline-demo
items.title: Redline: Details
items.description: A studio's "we sweat the details" section around a product card. Left alone, it tours the card's padding, the gap between the title and the price, the button's 44px height and the space around the photo. Point at anything to take over, click to pin, and hold Alt to measure between two parts. With `spec`, text shows its font.
items.author: KeyframeUI <https://keyframeui.com>

items.name: redline-tokens-demo
items.title: Redline: Design System
items.description: A settings panel where every spacing label reads as a token through `tokens`, and `selector="[data-redline]"` keeps the pointer on named parts. Pin a row, hold Alt and point at another to see the space between them.
items.author: KeyframeUI <https://keyframeui.com>

items.name: redline-handoff-demo
items.title: Redline: Dev Handoff
items.description: A design tool's handoff mode. `onSelect` fills the panel on the right with the CSS and the Tailwind classes of whatever layer is selected, and it swaps as you move.
items.author: KeyframeUI <https://keyframeui.com>

items.name: autopilot
items.title: Autopilot
items.description: A cursor that uses your product on its own. It glides to buttons and presses them, types and drags across real markup on a script you write, and steps aside the moment a visitor wants to try it.
items.author: KeyframeUI <https://keyframeui.com>

items.name: autopilot-demo
items.title: Autopilot: Agent at Work
items.description: An AI agent books a meeting in a calendar built from plain markup. It opens a new event, names it, finds a free slot, picks a guest from the autocomplete and sends the invite, narrating each step in its label. Move your mouse in or tab into it and it steps aside to the corner set with `park`; leave, and two seconds later it replays the chapter it was in.
items.author: KeyframeUI <https://keyframeui.com>

items.name: autopilot-multiplayer-demo
items.title: Autopilot: Design Review
items.description: Two teammates on a design canvas, with their steps running at the same time. Maya drags the Features frame into place, and its snap guides show through `data-autopilot-drop`, while Leo drops a comment pin and asks a question. Then Maya replies and Leo likes it. Move your mouse in and both step aside, and the canvas is yours: drag the frame or leave a comment.
items.author: KeyframeUI <https://keyframeui.com>

items.name: autopilot-onboarding-demo
items.title: Autopilot: Three Clicks
items.description: A SaaS app sets up a project in three clicks, one chapter each, with `chapterStrip` showing Create, Invite and Ship underneath. Click a chapter to jump there, or pause from the strip. On a phone, tap the app to take over and press Resume to hand it back.
items.author: KeyframeUI <https://keyframeui.com>

items.name: blueprint
items.title: Blueprint
items.description: A finished layout that builds itself. It starts as a wireframe measured from your real markup, then fills in block by block: text streams in, photos come into focus, buttons pop up. Scrub back and it comes apart again.
items.author: KeyframeUI <https://keyframeui.com>

items.name: blueprint-demo
items.title: Blueprint: Site Builder
items.description: An AI site builder's hero. A prompt types itself into the field, Enter goes down, and the field docks in the corner as the page builds beneath it. Each loop is a new prompt with different copy, colors and photos in the same layout, swapped in through `onLoop`, so the same wireframe turns into a different site. Hover to pause it.
items.author: KeyframeUI <https://keyframeui.com>

items.name: blueprint-process-demo
items.title: Blueprint: Studio Process
items.description: A case study that goes from an annotated blueprint to the finished design as you scroll, with `play="manual"` following `useScroll`. `data-blueprint-order` groups the build into type, imagery and surfaces, and `onBlockChange` lights up the matching stage in the rail. Scroll back up and it comes apart.
items.author: KeyframeUI <https://keyframeui.com>

items.name: blueprint-dashboard-demo
items.title: Blueprint: Generated Dashboard
items.description: An analytics assistant answers with a dashboard card. KPIs count up through `data-blueprint-count`, chart bars grow from even placeholders into their real heights through `--blueprint-progress`, and table rows fill in cell by cell. Drag the scrubber to take it apart and put it back.
items.author: KeyframeUI <https://keyframeui.com>

items.name: sentence-form
items.title: Sentence Form
items.description: A contact form written as a sentence. Blanks stretch as you type, picked options fly up into place while the words make room, and on send the form settles into the sentence you wrote.
items.author: KeyframeUI <https://keyframeui.com>

items.name: sentence-form-demo
items.title: Sentence Form: Project Brief
items.description: A design studio's inquiry in large serif type. Type your name and the words after it make room; pick services and each one flies up from the tray while the list grammar ("a website, a product, and motion") rearranges around it. Tap an outline in the tray to send a pick back down. Try Other for the timeline, send it half-filled to see the check, then send it for real: the form settles into the note you wrote, with an Edit link.

items.name: pricing-dock

items.author: KeyframeUI <https://keyframeui.com>

items.name: xray-lens
items.title: Xray Lens
items.description: A loupe over a polished UI. Inside the glass the surface peels away to the layer underneath, such as model tokens, raw JSON or latency telemetry, lined up with the parts it explains. A switch floods it over the whole card.
items.author: KeyframeUI <https://keyframeui.com>

items.name: xray-lens-demo
items.title: Xray Lens: Model Output
items.description: A support ticket triaged by an AI. items.name: xray-lens-trace-demo
items.title: Xray Lens: Request Trace

items.author: KeyframeUI <https://keyframeui.com>

items.name: circuit
items.title: Circuit
items.description: Right-angle circuit traces between the cards you already have, with signals that travel through them. items.title: Circuit: Agent Orchestrator

items.author: KeyframeUI <https://keyframeui.com>

items.title: Lodestone
